A '''diamond pickaxe''' is the [[Diamond equipment|diamond]] [[Tools#Pickaxe|pickaxe]], crafted from three [[diamond]]s and two sticks. It is the first pickaxe that harvests obsidian, which it breaks unusually fast.

{{Recipes}}

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===
It breaks pickaxe blocks at speed 9 and has 2500 durability (vanilla: 1561). Obsidian, crying obsidian and ender chests break at speed 35.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/block/obsidian_based.json}}</ref>

The pack also makes glass, glass panes, glowstone, sea lanterns and mob heads pickaxe blocks.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/pickaxe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|5}} damage at an attack speed of 1.2.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[diamond]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into one diamond. It is the base for both [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] and [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] upgrades.
